brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Three keyhole hanger accessories installed on rear face slot 4 of each cell: accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 on 3-cell horizontal bar (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full)

Five hex-acc-hook wall hooks installed on front faces: slots 1 on all three cells plus slot 2 on outer cells (accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1, accessory:0#-1,0#2, accessory:0#1,0#2) – forms repeating hook rail for pliers, screwdrivers, tape measures etc.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell horizontal wall rail with keyhole hangers on the back for wall mounting and 5 hooks on the front for small hand tools. Props to demonstrate hanging were refused by configurator (PROP_NO_REST through bench) because wall-mounted props have no bench clearance in preview, but hooks are correctly placed and functional in real wall use.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
